rejection_method: preselection complete-block eligibility filtering by exact prior-run status only; uniform sampling among viable candidates
scientific_rule: Old pairs were retained solely by sequence identity, dataset membership, and their predefined perturbation condition. No B22, prediction, OCN, simulation outcome, charge, hydropathy, length or other ranking was used. Only dataset_new_pairs_to_run_140.txt and nondataset_new_pairs_to_run_140.txt are new simulation submission lists. Full panel lists also contain already-run pairs and must not be submitted wholesale. No non-dataset TAD was shuffled, no RGG paired with a non-dataset TAD was shuffled, and no RGG shuffle was newly generated. The original simulation_pair_names_400.txt and all biological source inputs are preserved. No simulations, B22 calculations or model fitting were performed.
